content.short: Helium is a decentralized wireless network (DePIN) on Solana that rewards users for providing LoRaWAN and 5G coverage.
content.description:
Helium is a decentralized physical infrastructure network (DePIN) that creates a global, wireless network for IoT and 5G devices. By utilizing user-operated hotspots, Helium provides a low-cost and scalable alternative to traditional telecommunications infrastructure. The network's migration to the Solana blockchain has enhanced its scalability and performance, allowing for faster transactions and broader ecosystem integration.

Participants in the Helium network earn tokens for providing coverage and transferring data, creating a community-driven model for wireless connectivity. This decentralized approach democratizes access to communication tools and fosters innovation in the Internet of Things space. Helium empowers individuals to build and manage a global network that supports millions of connected devices.
